Crown or Pass 👑

Welcome to Crown or Pass 👑 the ultimate outfit-judging runway game! Who has the best style? 👗✨

🎭 Choose your role:

📋 Judges: Rate each outfit based on its creativity, style, and theme. Does the look deserve a CROWN?

🌟 Contestants: Create your best outfit, walk the runway, and impress the judges to become Best Dressed!

💬 Keep all votes and feedback friendly and focused on the outfits, not the players.

🎉 Having fun? Support the game by leaving a 👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite!
